title: Our brand model
slide_intent: Bring the organization’s ideas into one reference so a communicator can see how a local point of entry connects to the larger promise.
strategic_value: Special Olympics can connect sports, health, education and community activity to one model while assigning different jobs to mission, personality and action.
demonstration: A boxed diagram relates entry points, guiding idea and personality above mission, promise, action and benefits. Short definitions below explain the labels in the diagram.
practical_value: Locate a proposed story’s entry point and trace it to the promise and action it should communicate.

content_islands.name: Model introduction
content_islands.spec: Set the main purpose of the model in a narrow left column beside the diagram.

content_islands.name: Brand model
content_islands.spec: Box the model and label its parts in red. Place the guiding idea at top center, with the promise in red and action in black below.

content_islands.name: Terms
content_islands.spec: Arrange short definitions in columns beneath the diagram. Repeat the red labels so each definition is easy to match to its place in the model.
